title: QUIC RFC 9000 Stream Limit Enforcement and Blocked Open Tail Verification
verification_method: Focused S4P6 requirement-home tests over stream-limit local opens, inbound STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR handling, and blocked-open STREAMS_BLOCKED frame production, followed by Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the generated non-clean S4P6 stream-limit enforcement and blocked-open tail selected after S5P1P1 closure.
expected_result: The focused tests show that local stream opens stay within peer-advertised bidirectional and unidirectional stream limits, inbound STREAM frames at the advertised limit are accepted, the first inbound stream is rejected with STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR when the corresponding limit is zero, and blocked local opens return correctly shaped STREAMS_BLOCKED frames while the existing active-runtime proof continues to cover protected STREAMS_BLOCKED emission.
procedure: Run the focused S4P6 requirement-home filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The active STREAMS_BLOCKED sender path remains closed under ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0007.
The base stream-state model remains owned by ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0001.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim automatic stream-limit autotuning, public stream API widening, broader stream-management parity, hosted interop readiness, or closure of the deferred S4P6-0009 fuzz expectation.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The focused S4P6 filter passed 11/11, the Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S4P6-0008, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S4P6-0009, and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S4P6-0012 trace_clean and reports 1,299 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 472 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,550/4,550, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
